fx_eurusd_1h.scaler_fit_population: train rows of the fold, shared by every arm of the fold
fx_eurusd_1h.metric_formula: MAE_z = mean|yhat-y|/sd_train per horizon and fold; RMSE_z; skill = 1 - MAE_z_model/MAE_z_naive
fx_eurusd_1h.metric_aggregation: per horizon, fold, seed and arm; paired by origin
fx_eurusd_1h.naive_baseline: persistence: the origin's close, on identical origins
fx_eurusd_1h.permitted_inputs: OHLC of the served bars, window 60
